meta.title: DevCity: learn to code by exploring a city
meta.description: A free, curated library and real project tracks for junior developers, in a cyberpunk city.

hub.title: Welcome to DevCity
hub.subtitle: A city for learning to code: a library of free content and real project tracks, from your first HTML to AI apps.
hub.districtsSubtitle: Each district is a track. Each project is a building that lights up as you progress.
hub.libraryTagline: Free books, videos, docs and courses, curated and organized by technology.
hub.libraryCount: {count, plural, one {# free resource} other {# free resources}}
hub.projectsCount: {count, plural, =0 {Projects under construction} one {# project} other {# projects}}

progress.title: Your progress
progress.noNextStep: You finished every available step in this track. Pick another district!
progress.localOnly: Your progress is saved only in this browser.
progress.localOnlyHint: Export a backup file so you don't lose anything when switching browsers or clearing data.
progress.importInvalidJson: This file is not valid JSON.
progress.importNotDevcity: This file is not a DevCity backup.
progress.importNewerVersion: This backup comes from a newer version of DevCity. Reload the page and try again.
progress.resetConfirm: Erase all progress in this browser? This cannot be undone.

track.emptyProjects: This district doesn't have projects yet.
track.projectHow: Each building in this district adds a new part to the same project. Go in order: each part builds on the previous one.

project.prerequisitesNone: No prerequisites: you can start right away!

project.commonErrors: Something went wrong? Common errors and fixes

project.notTranslated: This content hasn't been translated to English yet, so it's shown in Portuguese.

city.regionLabel: DevCity 3D city. Use the destinations list to navigate with the keyboard.
city.webglUnavailable: Your browser can't draw 3D (WebGL), so DevCity is in 2D mode.
city.reducedMotionNotice: Your system asks for less motion, so we opened in 2D mode. To see the city, use the "3D city" button at the top.
city.hint: Click a building or sign to travel there. Drag to rotate the camera, use the mouse wheel to zoom and F to fly.
city.projectComplete: Sign lit! You finished this project.
city.freeHelpDesktop: Click the scene to fly. WASD or arrows move, the mouse looks, Space goes up and Shift goes down. Esc releases the mouse and F returns to Travel mode.
city.freeHelpTouch: Use the joystick to move and drag the screen to look. ▲ ▼ go up and down.
city.performanceNotice: The 3D city was too slow on this device, so we opened the 2D version. All the content is here.
city.slowNotice: The city is running slowly on this device. 2D mode has all the content and is much lighter.
